convex_s2_formula: For p occupied pairs, write 15=q*p+r (0<=r<p). Discrete convexity minimizes S2 with p-r overlaps q and r overlaps q+1; all other pairs have overlap 0.

prior_closed_profile_families.source: same-profile prior exact-closure certificate; not reanalyzed

s3_relaxation.certificate: exact rational dual inequalities checked in Python
s3_relaxation.local_event: J(a,b,c,z), the exact three-ticket Venn intersection count
s3_relaxation.pair_histogram_condition: For each m=0..5, local triple rows contain 8*n_m pair slots of multiplicity m, where n_m is fixed by the exact histogram.
s3_relaxation.relaxation: nonnegative LP over local pattern counts and degree classes
s3_relaxation.solver: OR-Tools GLOP, single thread; no CP-SAT
s3_relaxation.triple_double_intersection_condition: If t_m is the number of triple-label pair incidences on pairs of multiplicity m, then t_m<=m*n_m; the residual 15-12=3 incidences are exactly the three double labels. z records triple labels common to each local ticket triple.

vertex_incidence_degree_condition.degree_histogram_relaxation: Each vertex occurs in 36 of the 120 local triples; the LP uses nonnegative degree-class counts summing to ten and eighteen total incidences.
